product.title: Mt. Rainier Tour and Guided Hike

description.text: Combine a Mount Rainier National Park tour from Seattle with guided hiking on alpine trails. The outing includes old-growth forest walks, waterfall stops, and glacier viewpoints with trekking poles and seasonal snowshoes provided when needed.

highlights: Guided hike in Mount Rainier National Park
Old-growth forest and waterfall trail segments
Trekking poles and snowshoes provided seasonally
Lunch and snacks included on the tour day

start.description: Pickup from a central Seattle meeting point confirmed after booking.

end.description: Return to the Seattle departure location.

itineraryItems.title: Guided trail hike
itineraryItems.description: Hike a guide-selected alpine trail with trekking poles provided for steady footing.

itineraryItems.title: Narada Falls
itineraryItems.description: Stop at Narada Falls for photos and short walks when trail conditions allow.

itineraryItems.title: Glacier viewpoints
itineraryItems.description: Reach scenic overlooks for Mount Rainier glacier and valley perspectives.
